title: Thermal treatment options for biosolids management: a critical review
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2026, 12,93-120
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00569H, Critical Review
Savankumar Patel, Ibrahim Gbolahan Hakeem, Mojtaba Hedayati Marzbali, Pobitra Halder, Arun K. Vuppaladadiyam, Lalit Kumar, Aravind Surapaneni, Abhishek Sharma, Damien J. Batstone, Kalpit Shah
Thermal treatment of biosolids is gaining traction for volume reduction, contaminant destruction, and biochar and bioenergy production. However, the integration of thermal treatment technologies into wastewater treatment plants remains challenging.
